services.name: Domestic tour packages
services.description: Ready-to-book holidays across India — Goa beaches, Kerala backwaters, Rajasthan's royal circuit, Himalayan Sikkim and more — each with a day-by-day plan you can adjust before confirming.

services.name: International tour packages
services.description: Curated trips from short-haul favourites (Dubai, Thailand, Singapore, Maldives, Baku) to the European classics (Switzerland, Paris and the French Riviera), planned around Indian passports' visa realities.

services.name: Fully customized trips
services.description: Start from a blank page: tell us your dates, budget, departure city and travel style on WhatsApp, and we build an itinerary from scratch — nothing pre-packaged.

services.name: Honeymoon & couples planning
services.description: Romance-first versions of our routes — Maldives overwater stays, Swiss rail journeys, Kerala houseboats — with the logistics kept invisible.

services.name: Family holiday planning
services.description: Itineraries that actually work with kids: sensible pacing, family-friendly stays, and activity days balanced with downtime.

services.name: Visa and travel-document guidance
services.description: We tell you exactly what your destination requires of an Indian passport — Schengen appointments, e-visas, arrival cards — and help you get it right the first time.
